notes: Illustrative assumptions, not calibrated Guam operations. Historical evidence: May 30 2025 board snapshot lists 3 gantries up, 35 tractors on hand with 18 up, and 10 top lifters with 4 up. FY2024 report vessel net moves/hour is not an individual crane rate; the 15 crane moves/hour is a scenario assumption. Layout, dimensions, yard slots, dwell, and transport timings require observed validation. 168h/24h and recommendation replication screens are prototype choices, not industry standards.
